To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IISER Pune to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IISER Pune Sports Coach recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the IISER Pune Sports Coach (Part-time) posts is 18 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Sports Coach post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies for the Sports Coach (Part-time) positions across various sports disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Sports Coach role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a NIS Certificate course/Diploma in Coaching or B.P.Ed., along with a minimum of 2 years of coaching experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Sports Coach position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Sports Coach (Part-time) posts is 55 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Sports Coach position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is ₹ 825/- per session, with each session lasting 2.5 hours a day.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IISER Pune Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online through the official IISER Pune website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Sports Coach posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the tenure of the Sports Coach (Part-time) post?
faq.answer: The tenure for the Sports Coach (Part-time) posts is contractual, with the tenure end date specified as 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" link.
